title: Michigan Senate Candidate, a Former Trump Critic, Shifts Toward Election Skepticism
summary: Mike Rogers, the Republican nominee, has suggested that further scrutiny of the 2020 election was warranted and that voting irregularities sank his first Senate bid two years ago.
